title: Healthy Ola and Tom
text:
Ola likes healthy food. She eats apples and vegetables every day. She drinks a lot of water. She goes to bed early.

Her brother Tom likes sport. He plays football after school. He sleeps for nine hours every night. Ola and Tom are happy and healthy.

questions.text: What does Tom play after school?

options: She eats healthy food and goes to bed early
She eats a lot of sweets

questions.text: What can we say about Tom?

vocabulary.definition: good for your body and not making you ill
a clear liquid that people drink
physical activity such as football or running
rests with your eyes closed at night

paragraph_translations: Ola lubi zdrowe jedzenie. Je jabłka i warzywa każdego dnia. Pije dużo wody. Chodzi spać wcześnie.
Jej brat Tomek lubi sport. Po szkole gra w piłkę nożną. Śpi dziewięć godzin każdej nocy. Ola i Tomek są szczęśliwi i zdrowi.
